## pairwise log comparision: treatment*dosage*time

```{r}
alpha <- 0.05
c0 <- 1e-4
K <- ncol(fit_multinom$L)

# --- topic proportions and stable log transform ---
theta <- fit_multinom$L
stopifnot(nrow(theta) == nrow(meta_balanced))

eps_k <- c0 * colMedians(theta, na.rm = TRUE)
eps_k <- pmin(pmax(eps_k, 1e-12), 1e-2)

theta01 <- pmin(pmax(theta, 0), 1)
log_theta <- log(sweep(theta01, 2, eps_k, FUN = "+"))

# --- metadata / design ---
df_nocs <- droplevels(meta_balanced) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = droplevels(factor(treatment)),
    dosage    = droplevels(factor(dosage)),
    time      = droplevels(factor(time))
  )

df_nocs$cond <- interaction(df_nocs$treatment, df_nocs$dosage, df_nocs$time,
                            sep = "_", drop = TRUE)
df_nocs$cond <- relevel(df_nocs$cond, ref = "WT_0_0")

design_nocs <- model.matrix(~ cond, data = df_nocs)
colnames(design_nocs) <- make.names(colnames(design_nocs))
stopifnot(limma::is.fullrank(design_nocs))
```


## Build pairwise features and fit model

```{r}
parse_pairs <- function(pair_vec) {
  parts <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(pair_vec, "_vs_"))
  tibble(
    pair = pair_vec,
    k1 = as.integer(sub("^T", "", parts[, 1])),
    k2 = as.integer(sub("^T", "", parts[, 2]))
  )
}

build_pairwise_results <- function(log_theta, design, coef_pattern = "^cond", robust = TRUE) {
  K <- ncol(log_theta)
  pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))
  n_pairs <- nrow(pair_mat)

  log_ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(log_theta), ncol = n_pairs)
  for (p in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
    k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
    k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
    log_ratio_mat[, p] <- log_theta[, k1] - log_theta[, k2]
  }

  colnames(log_ratio_mat) <- apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) {
    paste0("T", idx[1], "_vs_T", idx[2])
  })

  Y_lr <- t(log_ratio_mat)

  fit_lr <- lmFit(Y_lr, design)
  fit_lr <- eBayes(fit_lr, robust = robust)

  coef_names <- colnames(fit_lr$coefficients)
  target_coefs <- grep(coef_pattern, coef_names, value = TRUE)

  res_pairs_all <- bind_rows(lapply(target_coefs, function(cf) {
    tt <- topTable(fit_lr, coef = cf, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
    tt$coef <- cf
    tt$pair <- rownames(tt)
    tt
  }))

  pair_info <- parse_pairs(rownames(Y_lr))

  res_long <- res_pairs_all %>%
    left_join(pair_info, by = "pair") %>%
    select(coef, pair, logFC, adj.P.Val, P.Value, k1, k2)

  res_directed <- bind_rows(
    res_long %>% transmute(coef, pair, topic = k1, other = k2,
                           beta =  logFC, q = adj.P.Val, p = P.Value),
    res_long %>% transmute(coef, pair, topic = k2, other = k1,
                           beta = -logFC, q = adj.P.Val, p = P.Value)
  )

  list(
    Y_lr = Y_lr,
    fit_lr = fit_lr,
    res_pairs_all = res_pairs_all,
    res_long = res_long,
    res_directed = res_directed
  )
}

pw_nocs <- build_pairwise_results(log_theta, design_nocs, coef_pattern = "^cond", robust = TRUE)

res_long_nocs <- pw_nocs$res_long
res_directed_nocs <- pw_nocs$res_directed

```



## Topic-level summaries

```{r}
topic_summary_nocs <- res_directed_nocs %>%
  group_by(coef, topic) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total  = sum(!is.na(q)),
    n_sig    = sum(q < alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_sig = n_sig / n_total,
    S        = min(abs(beta), na.rm = TRUE),
    other_min = other[which.min(abs(beta))][1],
    beta_min  = beta[which.min(abs(beta))][1],
    Q_worst   = max(q, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    topic = paste0("T", topic),
    other_min = paste0("T", other_min)
  )

topic_summary_max_nocs <- res_directed_nocs %>%
  group_by(coef, topic) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total  = sum(!is.na(q)),
    n_sig    = sum(q < alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_sig = n_sig / n_total,
    S_max    = max(abs(beta), na.rm = TRUE),
    other_max = other[which.max(abs(beta))][1],
    beta_max  = beta[which.max(abs(beta))][1],
    Q_best   = min(q, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q_worst  = max(q, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    topic = paste0("T", topic),
    other_max = paste0("T", other_max)
  )
```


## Parse coefficients for plotting

```{r}
parse_cond_fields <- function(dat) {
  dat %>%
    mutate(coef_raw = sub("^cond", "", coef)) %>%
    separate(coef_raw, into = c("treatment","dosage","time"),
             sep = "_", remove = FALSE, fill = "right") %>%
    mutate(
      dosage = factor(dosage, levels = c("10","20","30")),
      time_num = as.numeric(time),
      time = factor(time, levels = sort(unique(as.numeric(time))))
    )
}

plot_df_nocs <- topic_summary_nocs %>%
  parse_cond_fields() %>%
  filter(treatment != "WT") %>%
  mutate(topic_id = as.integer(sub("^T", "", topic)))

plot_df_max_nocs <- topic_summary_max_nocs %>%
  parse_cond_fields() %>%
  filter(treatment != "WT") %>%
  mutate(topic_id = as.integer(sub("^T", "", topic)))
```


## Heatmaps

```{r}
plot_topic_heatmap <- function(dat, fill_var, fill_lab, ttl) {
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = time, y = topic, fill = .data[[fill_var]])) +
    geom_tile() +
    facet_grid(dosage ~ treatment, scales = "free_x") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
    labs(x = "Time", y = "Topic", fill = fill_lab, title = ttl)
}

p_frac_nocs <- plot_topic_heatmap(
  plot_df_nocs, "frac_sig", "Fraction\nsignificant",
  "Fraction significant (no cell_state in design)"
)

p_S_nocs <- plot_topic_heatmap(
  plot_df_nocs, "S", "Least-extreme\n|beta|",
  "Topic distinctness S = min|beta| (no cell_state in design)"
)

p_Smax_nocs <- plot_topic_heatmap(
  plot_df_max_nocs, "S_max", "Most-extreme\n|beta|",
  "Topic strongest contrast S_max = max|beta| (no cell_state in design)"
)

p_frac_nocs
p_S_nocs
p_Smax_nocs
```


## Line plots by topic blocks

```{r}
make_topic_block_plot <- function(dat, yvar, ylab, ttl, lo, hi) {
  ggplot(
    dat %>% filter(topic_id >= lo, topic_id <= hi),
    aes(x = time_num, y = .data[[yvar]],
        color = treatment, linetype = dosage,
        group = interaction(treatment, dosage))
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 1.3) +
    facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(5, 10, 30, 240, 1440)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      strip.text  = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
    labs(x = "Time (log scale)", y = ylab, title = ttl)
}

p1_nocs_logx <- make_topic_block_plot(
  plot_df_nocs, "S",
  "Least-extreme |beta| = min over other topics",
  "Topic distinctness over time (no cell_state) — T1–T8", 1, 8
)

p2_nocs_logx <- make_topic_block_plot(
  plot_df_nocs, "S",
  "Least-extreme |beta| = min over other topics",
  "Topic distinctness over time (no cell_state) — T9–T16", 9, 16
)

p1_max_nocs_logx <- make_topic_block_plot(
  plot_df_max_nocs, "S_max",
  "Most-extreme |beta| = max over other topics",
  "Most-extreme topic contrast over time (no cell_state) — T1–T8", 1, 8
)

p2_max_nocs_logx <- make_topic_block_plot(
  plot_df_max_nocs, "S_max",
  "Most-extreme |beta| = max over other topics",
  "Most-extreme topic contrast over time (no cell_state) — T9–T16", 9, 16
)

p1_nocs_logx
p2_nocs_logx
p1_max_nocs_logx
p2_max_nocs_logx
```


## Beta trajectory for one topic

```{r}
make_tk_plot_nocs <- function(res_directed, topic_k, alpha = 0.05, K = 16) {
  plot_tk <- res_directed %>%
    filter(topic == topic_k, other != topic_k) %>%
    mutate(coef_raw = sub("^cond", "", coef)) %>%
    separate(coef_raw, into = c("treatment","dosage","time"),
             sep = "_", remove = FALSE, fill = "right") %>%
    mutate(
      time = as.numeric(time),
      dosage = factor(dosage, levels = c("10","20","30")),
      other_id = other,
      other = paste0("T", other),
      other = factor(other, levels = paste0("T", setdiff(seq_len(K), topic_k))),
      sig = q < alpha
    ) %>%
    filter(treatment != "WT")

  make_panel <- function(dat, ttl) {
    ggplot(dat, aes(x = time, y = beta,
                    group = interaction(treatment, dosage),
                    color = treatment, linetype = dosage)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
      geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 1.8) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1, `TRUE` = 16)) +
      facet_wrap(~ other, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
      scale_x_log10(breaks = c(5, 10, 30, 240, 1440)) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        strip.text  = element_text(size = 7)
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "Time",
        y = "beta",
        shape = "BH < 0.05",
        title = ttl
      )
  }

  list(
    p_1_8 = make_panel(
      filter(plot_tk, other_id %in% 1:8),
      paste0("T", topic_k, " vs other topics (T1–T8) — no cell_state in design")
    ),
    p_9_16 = make_panel(
      filter(plot_tk, other_id %in% 9:16),
      paste0("T", topic_k, " vs other topics (T9–T16) — no cell_state in design")
    )
  )
}

topic15_plots <- make_tk_plot_nocs(res_directed_nocs, topic_k = 15, alpha = alpha, K = K)
topic15_plots$p_1_8
topic15_plots$p_9_16

topic3_plots <- make_tk_plot_nocs(res_directed_nocs, topic_k = 3, alpha = alpha, K = K)
topic3_plots$p_1_8
topic3_plots$p_9_16
```
